name: "Development Stage"
applyTo: "stories/**/implementation-notes.md"

# Development Stage Rules

- Record what code changed, why it changed, and what assumptions or risks remain.
- Preserve enough evidence for Review and QA to validate the implementation without reconstructing intent.
- Do not mix test evidence, release conclusions, or final approval decisions into the development artifact.
- Call out any unresolved gaps that QA or Review must validate explicitly.
- Keep the artifact aligned to the approved scope and architecture, without expanding the story.
